Risks.riskTitle: Lack visibility into scope of work
Risks.riskDescription:
Context: Project runs in T&M model, with no onshore & only offshore team working directly with McK team who owns program management, sprint and design.
Condition: Team lacks overall context and design and there were changes in requirement wrt skill set and tasks getting allocated and involvement in sprint calls started only from last sprint started on 04/22 but not consistently included in all key Scrum meetings
Consequence: Billing impact no work allocated to a few engineers due to scope alignment issues and limiting visibility into scope, priorities, and decision-making which could lead to quality concerns
Risks.mitigation:
Project Closed

Working closely with client lead to align him with concerns and getting process streamlined. Additionally, daily connects established with single Poc on tasks assigned so that deliverables are not impacted. Access to recordings requested for design calls happens outside offshore hours.

Risks.riskDescription:
Context: Projects objective is to automate claims adjudication SOP manuals and includes data integration from FACETS. Sprint commitments and resource allocation are now dependent on finalizing FACETS integration approach and related leadership decisions from a workshop between client & FACETS team in May last week
Condition: Workshop was conducted to understand FACETS integration and multiple options were discussed on the approaches on data retrieval to perform SOP automation. The final approach is pending with leadership, and this has impact on PBI/task readiness, resulting in limited task availability for Ascendion offshore engineers. 
Consequence: Reduced resource utilization and risk of delayed sprint progress, potentially impacting sprint commitments and delivery timelines.
Risks.mitigation:
Project Closed

Request to expedite decisions and prepare alternate sprint-ready work items to Premera and McK respectively. Add any mid sprints tasks only as spikes so that say do is not impacted.

Risks.riskDescription:
Context: Concerns received on code quality based on PR comments from McK
Condition: Reviewed the code base and the samples shared and found they are more related to the internal PR conversations and due to dependency mappings / changes mid sprint. 
Consequence: Team morale and rapport with full team will be impacted if there are misalignment again
Risks.mitigation: Informed client leads on review details. Additionally, measures have made stringent on code review process, identify gaps, conduct internal draft PR process, training session etc.

Risks.riskTitle: Client Confidence in AI Delivery Capability
Risks.riskDescription:
Context: The client selected our organization based on our proven experience and expertise in the AI space and expects the team to provide proactive AI-driven recommendations, innovative solutions, and value-added insights beyond core delivery.
Condition: The delivered code and outcomes have not consistently reflected the expected level of AI expertise, and communication gaps have further reduced the confidence of offshore contributions and technical capabilities. Also, there has not come up with proactive solutioning, and value-add contributions, leading to doubts about whether the project is staffed with the right capabilities to meet their expectations.
Consequence: Client perception of offshore AI competency may be impacted, potentially affecting confidence, increased scrutiny and escalations, lower stakeholder satisfaction, reluctance to approve future work, and potential impact to account growth and project continuity.
Risks.mitigation: Enable offshore engineers technically and process wise with help of SMEs, circle leaders to proactively showcase offshore AI capabilities through regular solution demonstrations, code walkthroughs, architectural contributions, and improved stakeholder communication. Also, include AI-focused achievements, innovation ideas, and realized value-adds in regular governance reports.
